entries.zh: 工程师查看天气预报时，火箭矗立在发射台上。

entries.meaningZh: 冒……风险；把……置于可能受损的境地
entries.en: He would not lay his reputation on the line for an untested plan.
entries.zh: 他不愿为了一个未经检验的计划拿自己的声誉冒险。

entries.meaningZh: 按手动作；把手按在他人身上的行为，本例指宗教礼仪
entries.en: The service included the laying on of hands as the new minister was welcomed.
entries.zh: 欢迎新牧师的礼拜中包括按手仪式。

entries.meaningZh: 逐步引出；为……作铺垫（常接to）
entries.en: The opening anecdotes lead up to the main argument of the lecture.
entries.zh: 开头几则轶事逐步引出了讲座的主要论点。

entries.meaningZh: （棒球）首位上场击球的活动或角色；本例为名词性活动义
entries.en: Leading off suited him better than batting in the middle of the order.
entries.zh: 担任首位击球手比在打线中段出场更适合他。

entries.meaningZh: 引导转向的缰绳；用以引导马头向左或向右的缰
entries.en: The worn leading rein was replaced before the next riding lesson.
entries.zh: 下一堂骑术课前，磨损的引导缰被换掉了。

entries.meaningZh: 腐叶土；主要由腐解树叶形成的腐殖质土壤或园艺材料
entries.en: The gardener mixed leaf soil into the border before planting the bulbs.
entries.zh: 园丁在种球根前，先把腐叶土拌进花境的土里。

entries.meaningZh: 叶苔；具有茎状轴及细小叶状结构的苔类植物
entries.en: Under the lens, the leafy liverwort showed rows of tiny overlapping leaflike structures.
entries.zh: 在放大镜下，那株叶苔显出一排排细小、相互重叠的叶状结构。

entries.meaningZh: 学习障碍；本例取美式教育语境中的特定学习技能困难义
entries.en: The school in Ohio arranged extra reading support for a pupil with a learning disability.
entries.zh: 俄亥俄州那所学校为一名有学习障碍的学生安排了额外的阅读支持。

entries.meaningZh: （音乐）加线；五线谱上方或下方用于记写超出谱表范围音符的短线
entries.en: The high note sat on a ledger line above the staff.
entries.zh: 那个高音记在五线谱上方的一条加线上。

entries.meaningZh: 舞台左侧；演员面向观众时在其左手边的舞台区域
entries.en: The stage manager's plan divided the stage into left stage, centre stage, and right stage.
entries.zh: 舞台监督的平面图将舞台划分为演员视角的左侧、中央和右侧区域。

entries.meaningZh: 法律关系；本例取受法律规范的律师与客户之间的职业关系义
entries.en: The retainer agreement set out the legal relation between the lawyer and her client.
entries.zh: 委托协议明确了律师与其客户之间的法律关系。

entries.meaningZh: 调平装置；使表面或设备达到水平的器件（本例为工具义）
entries.en: The technician adjusted the leveler until the platform was horizontal.
entries.zh: 技术员调整调平装置，直到平台处于水平状态。

entries.meaningZh: 维护者；负责维持或维护工作的人（本例为软件项目人员义）
entries.en: The software maintainer reviewed the patch before the next release.
entries.zh: 软件维护者在下一个版本发布前审查了这个补丁。

entries.meaningZh: 漫无边际的；东拉西扯的；缺乏明确方向的
entries.en: His meandering answer left us unsure what he had actually decided.
entries.zh: 他东拉西扯的回答让我们仍不清楚他到底作出了什么决定。

entries.meaningZh: 测量人员；进行测量的人（本例为人员义）
entries.en: Each measurer recorded the child's height twice to check the reading.
entries.zh: 每名测量人员都记录了两次孩子的身高，以核对读数。

entries.meaningZh: 祭台台面；祭坛的水平桌面（教会建筑用语，源于拉丁语）
entries.en: The restorer examined a crack in the stone mensa of the altar.
entries.zh: 修复师检查了祭坛石质台面上的一道裂缝。

entries.meaningZh: 微型机械；具有微小机械结构的装置（本例为微机电装置义，不等同于微型计算机）
entries.en: Under the microscope, the students watched a micromachine turn a tiny gear.
entries.zh: 学生们通过显微镜观察一台微型机械转动一个微小齿轮。

entries.meaningZh: 爱占便宜的人；总想从别人那里白拿东西的人（非正式、贬义）
entries.en: He stopped inviting the moocher who never paid for a meal.
entries.zh: 他不再邀请那个吃饭从不付钱、总爱占便宜的人。

entries.meaningZh: 纳米机器；通过纳米技术构建、在极微小尺度运作的机器，不必是计算机
entries.en: The team tested whether the nanomachine could move a tiny load across the surface.
entries.zh: 研究团队测试了这台纳米机器能否在表面移动一个微小的负载。

entries.meaningZh: 黑质；substantia nigra在神经科学语境中的简称，不是族群称呼
entries.en: The researchers compared neuron counts in the nigra with those in nearby brain regions.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了黑质与附近脑区的神经元数量。

entries.meaningZh: 诺如病毒；可引起急性胃肠炎的一类病毒
entries.en: The school reported a norovirus outbreak after several pupils developed stomach symptoms.
entries.zh: 几名学生出现胃肠道症状后，学校报告了一起诺如病毒暴发。

entries.meaningZh: 辅助医疗的；与协助医生、护士工作的专业人员有关的
entries.en: Paramedical staff helped prepare the patient for transport.
entries.zh: 辅助医疗人员协助做好了转运病人的准备。

entries.meaningZh: 与男童发生性行为的成年男子（正式用语，不等同于泛指同性恋者）
entries.en: The article condemned the pederast's exploitation of boys.
entries.zh: 这篇文章谴责了那名成年男子对男童的性侵害。

entries.meaningZh: 康复医学专科医生；物理医学与康复医学医师
entries.en: After the spinal injury, a physiatrist coordinated his rehabilitation plan.
entries.zh: 脊柱受伤后，一名康复医学专科医生统筹了他的康复方案。

entries.meaningZh: 恳求、央求某人
entries.en: She went to plead with the landlord for another week to move her belongings.
entries.zh: 她去恳求房东再给她一个星期搬走自己的物品。

entries.meaningZh: 龇牙咧嘴的僵硬表情；固定的怪笑
entries.en: His smile hardened into a rictus when he heard the accusation.
entries.zh: 听到指控时，他的笑容僵成了龇牙咧嘴的怪笑。

entries.meaningZh: 感官的；涉及或源于感觉的（本例为一般感官义）
entries.en: The workshop used sand, fabric and music to create a rich sensorial experience.
entries.zh: 工作坊利用沙子、织物和音乐营造丰富的感官体验。

entries.meaningZh: 塞拉（Junipero Serra，18世纪在墨西哥和加利福尼亚传教的西班牙传教士）
entries.en: The museum panel examined Serra's role in the California missions.
entries.zh: 博物馆的展板探讨了塞拉在加利福尼亚传教站体系中的作用。

entries.meaningZh: 不择手段的讼棍；以不道德手法行事的人，尤指律师或政客（贬义）
entries.en: The client regretted trusting a shyster who had promised an easy victory.
entries.zh: 那位委托人后悔相信了一个许诺能轻松胜诉的讼棍。

entries.meaningZh: 角宿一；室女座最亮的恒星，实为一个紧密的双星系统（本例为天文义）
entries.en: Spica was low in the eastern sky when the observers began their session.
entries.zh: 观测者开始观测时，角宿一位于东方低空。

entries.meaningZh: 立体定向的；利用空间定位来精确确定目标或器械位置的（本例为医学义）
entries.en: The stereotactic frame helped the team position the instrument precisely.
entries.zh: 立体定向框架帮助团队精确定位器械。

entries.meaningZh: 胸锁乳突肌；位于颈部、参与头颈转动的成对肌肉
entries.en: The physiotherapist checked his sternocleidomastoid while he slowly turned his head.
entries.zh: 他缓慢转头时，物理治疗师检查了他的胸锁乳突肌。

entries.meaningZh: 在牧草地继续饲养、供后续育肥的幼牛（本例为肉牛业义）
entries.en: The rancher bought a stocker to graze on the spring pasture.
entries.zh: 牧场主买了一头供后续育肥的幼牛，让它在春季牧场上放牧。

entries.meaningZh: 时间跨度；两个事件之间或某项过程持续的一段时间（本例为普通名词义）
entries.en: The two surveys covered the same timespan but used different sampling methods.
entries.zh: 这两次调查涵盖了同一时间段，但采用了不同的抽样方法。

entries.meaningZh: 生育三烯酚；维生素E相关化合物中的一类，与生育酚有别
entries.en: The analysis measured each tocotrienol separately from the tocopherols in the oil.
entries.zh: 这项分析对油中的各种生育三烯酚与生育酚分别进行了测定。

entries.meaningZh: 圣餐变体说；天主教关于圣餐饼酒实体变化的教义（本例为宗教义）
entries.en: The lecturer explained transubstantiation during a discussion of the Eucharist.
entries.zh: 讲师在讨论圣餐礼时解释了圣餐变体说。

entries.meaningZh: 涡轮风扇发动机；借助涡轮驱动风扇产生推力的喷气发动机
entries.en: The engineer inspected the turbofan before the aircraft returned to service.
entries.zh: 飞机恢复运行前，工程师检查了涡轮风扇发动机。

entries.meaningZh: 未署名的；未在演职员名单中列出的（本例为电影义）
entries.en: She made an uncredited appearance in the film's opening scene.
entries.zh: 她在电影开场一幕中出演，但未在演职员名单中署名。

entries.meaningZh: 尚未测绘的；未在地图上标明的（本例为地域义）
entries.en: The expedition avoided the unmapped valley beyond the ridge.
entries.zh: 探险队避开了山脊另一侧尚未测绘的山谷。

entries.meaningZh: 卖主；商贩（vendor 的异体拼写）
entries.en: The fruit vender lowered the price as the market began to close.
entries.zh: 集市开始收摊时，水果商贩降低了售价。

entries.meaningZh: 逐步操作说明；详细演示（本例为软件使用说明义）
entries.en: The walkthrough showed me how to restore a deleted folder.
entries.zh: 这份逐步操作说明教我如何恢复已删除的文件夹。

entries.meaningZh: 水手御寒用的针织便帽
entries.en: Before stepping onto the cold deck, Mara pulled her watch cap down over her ears.
entries.zh: 走上寒冷的甲板之前，玛拉把针织水手帽往下拉，盖住了耳朵。

entries.meaningZh: 守夜礼拜，尤指除夕夜举行的礼拜
entries.en: The small chapel remained open for a watch night that ended just after midnight.
entries.zh: 小礼拜堂一直开着门，举行的守夜礼拜在午夜刚过时结束。

entries.meaningZh: 水生山核桃（Carya aquatica，北美的一种山核桃树）
entries.en: A young water bitternut was growing beside the flooded trail.
entries.zh: 一株幼小的水生山核桃长在被水淹没的小径旁。

entries.meaningZh: 大薸（Pistia stratiotes，一种浮水植物，亦称水浮莲）
entries.en: The pond keeper lifted a clump of water cabbage out of the narrow channel.
entries.zh: 池塘管理员从狭窄的水道里捞起了一丛大薸。

entries.meaningZh: Montia lamprosperma 的英文俗名，一种小型草本植物
entries.en: The botanist knelt beside the water chickweed to examine its tiny leaves.
entries.zh: 植物学家在那株 Montia lamprosperma 旁跪下，查看它细小的叶片。

entries.meaningZh: 美洲黄莲（Nelumbo lutea，一种开淡黄色花的水生植物）
entries.en: A water chinquapin opened its pale yellow flower above the broad leaves.
entries.zh: 一株美洲黄莲在宽大的叶片上方绽开了淡黄色的花。

entries.meaningZh: 水资源保护；节约用水
entries.en: The school made water conservation part of its plan to reduce waste.
entries.zh: 学校把节约用水纳入了减少浪费的计划。

entries.meaningZh: 水毛茛（Ranunculus aquatilis，一种水生毛茛）
entries.en: White flowers of water crowfoot dotted the quiet edge of the stream.
entries.zh: 水毛茛的白花点缀在溪流平静的边缘。

entries.meaningZh: 美洲榆（Ulmus americana）的一个英文别名
entries.en: The old water elm shaded nearly the entire front lawn.
entries.zh: 那棵老美洲榆几乎遮住了整个前院草坪。

entries.meaningZh: Hottonia inflata，一种北美水生草本植物
entries.en: The drawing shows a water gillyflower with its white flowers above the water.
entries.zh: 画中一株 Hottonia inflata 的白花伸出水面。

entries.meaningZh: 水生山核桃（Carya aquatica）
entries.en: The survey team marked a large water hickory near the riverbank.
entries.zh: 调查小组给河岸附近的一棵大水生山核桃做了标记。

entries.meaningZh: 美洲地笋（Lycopus americanus，一种多年生草本植物）
entries.en: We found water horehound growing among the taller herbs on the bank.
entries.zh: 我们发现美洲地笋长在岸边较高的草本植物之间。

entries.meaningZh: 樟叶西番莲的可食黄色果实
entries.en: She cut the water lemon in half and scooped out the pulp.
entries.zh: 她把樟叶西番莲的黄色果实切成两半，舀出了果肉。

entries.meaningZh: 河乌，一类会潜水觅食的小型鸟
entries.en: A water ouzel disappeared beneath the rushing stream and emerged beside a rock.
entries.zh: 一只河乌钻入湍急的溪水，又在一块岩石旁露了出来。

entries.meaningZh: 泽芹（Sium suave，一种生于浅水中的伞形科植物）
entries.en: The field guide helped us identify the white-flowered water parsnip beside the marsh.
entries.zh: 野外指南帮助我们认出了沼泽旁开白花的泽芹。

entries.meaningZh: 泽泻（Alisma plantago-aquatica，一种沼泽植物）
entries.en: A water plantain had taken root at the muddy edge of the pond.
entries.zh: 一株泽泻在池塘泥泞的边缘扎了根。

entries.meaningZh: 水蓝宝石，深蓝色堇青石的旧称
entries.en: The jeweller placed the water sapphire beside a card identifying it as cordierite.
entries.zh: 珠宝商把那颗水蓝宝石放在一张标明它是堇青石的卡片旁。

entries.meaningZh: 水堇（Hottonia palustris，一种水生植物）
entries.en: The water violet had several delicate flowers above its submerged foliage.
entries.zh: 那株水堇在水下的叶丛上方开着几朵娇小的花。

entries.meaningZh: 西瓜皮椒草（Peperomia argyreia，一种观叶植物）
entries.en: He moved the watermelon begonia to a shelf where its striped leaves could be seen clearly.
entries.zh: 他把西瓜皮椒草移到一个能清楚看到它条纹叶片的架子上。

entries.meaningZh: 编枝覆泥的建筑材料；荆条泥料
entries.en: The builders filled the timber frame with wattle and daub.
entries.zh: 工匠们用编枝覆泥的材料填满了木框架。

entries.meaningZh: 球兰（Hoya carnosa，一种攀援植物）
entries.en: The wax plant sent a new shoot around the thin support.
entries.zh: 那株球兰的新枝绕上了细支架。

entries.meaningZh: 单编结；用于临时连接绳索的绳结（sheet bend）
entries.en: The instructor loosened the weaver's hitch so that everyone could see how the two ropes crossed.
entries.zh: 教练松开了单编结，让大家看清两根绳子是怎样交叉的。

entries.meaningZh: 幕衣蛾（Tineola bisselliella，一种会结丝网的衣蛾）
entries.en: The conservator found a webbing clothes moth inside the box of wool samples.
entries.zh: 文物保护人员在装着羊毛样品的盒子里发现了一只幕衣蛾。

entries.meaningZh: 参加婚礼的一群人；婚礼队伍
entries.en: The photographer asked the wedding party to gather beside the steps.
entries.zh: 摄影师请婚礼队伍的人在台阶旁集合。

entries.meaningZh: 牛腰脊肉中靠近臀部的部分
entries.en: The butcher wrapped the wedge bone separately from the other cuts of beef.
entries.zh: 肉贩把靠近臀部的那块牛腰脊肉与其他牛肉部位分开包好。

entries.meaningZh: 举止规矩的；表现良好的
entries.en: The children were well behaved throughout the long ceremony.
entries.zh: 孩子们在整个漫长的仪式中都表现得很规矩。

entries.meaningZh: 涌出；大量流出
entries.en: Clear water began to well out of the crack in the rock.
entries.zh: 清水开始从岩石的裂缝中涌出。

entries.meaningZh: 西部低地大猩猩（Gorilla gorilla gorilla）
entries.en: The keeper watched the western lowland gorilla carry a branch into the shade.
entries.zh: 饲养员看着那只西部低地大猩猩把一根树枝带到阴凉处。

entries.meaningZh: 西式蛋饼三明治（夹西式煎蛋饼的三明治）
entries.en: I ordered a western sandwich and asked for the toast to be lightly browned.
entries.zh: 我点了一份西式蛋饼三明治，并请他们把吐司烤得略微焦黄。

entries.meaningZh: Piranga ludoviciana，北美西部的一种鸣禽
entries.en: A western tanager paused on the branch while we adjusted the binoculars.
entries.zh: 我们调整双筒望远镜时，一只 Piranga ludoviciana 停在了树枝上。

entries.meaningZh: 西部白松（Pinus monticola，北美的一种松树）
entries.en: The western white pine at the bend in the path was taller than the surrounding trees.
entries.zh: 小径拐弯处的西部白松比周围的树都高。

entries.meaningZh: 一粒完整的小麦籽粒
entries.en: She picked up a wheat berry and pointed out the crease along one side.
entries.zh: 她拿起一粒完整的麦粒，指出了它一侧的凹沟。

entries.meaningZh: 搅打至松软的奶油；打发奶油
entries.en: A spoonful of whipped cream slowly melted into the hot chocolate.
entries.zh: 一匙打发奶油慢慢融进了热巧克力里。

entries.meaningZh: 传声穹顶；能把特定位置的低声传到远处的穹顶空间
entries.en: At the whispering dome, we could hear a quiet voice from the opposite side.
entries.zh: 在传声穹顶下，我们能听到对面传来的轻声说话。

entries.meaningZh: 铁路沿线的小镇；小站所在的社区
entries.en: The train passed through a whistle stop with a single shop beside the tracks.
entries.zh: 火车经过一个铁路沿线小镇，铁轨旁只有一家商店。

entries.meaningZh: 白带蛱蝶（本例指欧亚种 Limenitis camilla）
entries.en: A white admiral settled on a leaf just beyond the shaded path.
entries.zh: 一只 Limenitis camilla 白带蛱蝶停在了阴凉小径旁的一片叶子上。

entries.meaningZh: 白果类叶升麻（旧学名 Actaea alba），一种结有毒白色浆果的草本植物
entries.en: The guide pointed to the white baneberry and told the group to leave its berries untouched.
entries.zh: 向导指着那株白果类叶升麻，告诉大家不要碰它的浆果。

entries.meaningZh: Actaea alba 的英文俗名，一种结白色有毒浆果的北美草本植物
entries.en: A cluster of white bead grew behind the low fence in the woodland garden.
entries.zh: 林地花园的矮篱笆后长着一丛结白色有毒浆果的 Actaea alba。

entries.meaningZh: 白色种子的食用菜豆；白芸豆
entries.en: A single white bean had fallen from the open bag onto the counter.
entries.zh: 一粒白芸豆从敞开的袋子里掉到了操作台上。

entries.meaningZh: 白花麦瓶草（Silene latifolia，亦曾称 Lychnis alba）
entries.en: The white campion opened its flowers as the evening light began to fade.
entries.zh: 暮色渐暗时，那株白花麦瓶草展开了花朵。

entries.meaningZh: 白刺盖太阳鱼（Pomoxis annularis，一种淡水鱼）
entries.en: The biologist measured the white crappie before returning it to the lake.
entries.zh: 生物学家测量了那条白刺盖太阳鱼，随后把它放回了湖里。

entries.meaningZh: 大西洋白柏（Chamaecyparis thyoides，一种北美柏树）
entries.en: The white cypress beside the boardwalk still had a narrow, dense crown.
entries.zh: 木栈道旁那棵大西洋白柏仍有着狭窄而浓密的树冠。

entries.meaningZh: 白柏松（Callitris glaucophylla，澳大利亚的一种柏科树木）
entries.en: A white cypress pine stood alone at the edge of the clearing.
entries.zh: 一棵白柏松独自长在林间空地的边缘。

entries.meaningZh: 白流苏兰（词典旧学名 Habenaria albiflora），一种北美湿地兰
entries.en: The photographer waited for the white fringed orchis to stop swaying in the breeze.
entries.zh: 摄影师等着那株白流苏兰不再随微风摇摆。

entries.meaningZh: 浪尖泛白的波浪；白浪
entries.en: A white horse broke across the dark surface of the bay.
entries.zh: 一道白浪在海湾深色的水面上翻涌开来。

entries.meaningZh: 白鲻（Mugil curema，一种银白色鲻鱼）
entries.en: A white mullet flashed beneath the surface beside the pier.
entries.zh: 码头旁水面下一条白鲻一闪而过。

entries.meaningZh: 白色野羊（本例为北美的 Dall sheep，词典旧名 Ovis montana dalli）
entries.en: The climbers noticed a white sheep standing on a ledge above the valley.
entries.zh: 登山者注意到一只白色野羊站在山谷上方的岩架上。

entries.meaningZh: 吉贝（Ceiba pentandra，一种热带大乔木）
entries.en: The white silk-cotton tree cast a broad shadow across the courtyard.
entries.zh: 那棵吉贝树在庭院里投下了一大片阴影。

entries.meaningZh: 白花草木樨（Melilotus alba）
entries.en: Bees moved from flower to flower on the white sweet clover beside the field.
entries.zh: 蜜蜂在田边白花草木樨的一朵朵花之间飞来飞去。

entries.meaningZh: 白尾飞机；已制造但尚无确定买主的飞机
entries.en: The manufacturer found a buyer for a white tail that had been parked outside the assembly hall.
entries.zh: 制造商为一架停在装配厂房外、尚无确定买主的白尾飞机找到了买家。

entries.meaningZh: 白色芜菁的肉质根
entries.en: He peeled the white turnip and cut it into thick wedges.
entries.zh: 他削去白芜菁的皮，把它切成厚块。

entries.meaningZh: Aster divaricatus，一种开白花的北美林地紫菀类植物
entries.en: The white wood aster spread into a small patch beneath the trees.
entries.zh: 那种开白花的 Aster divaricatus 在树下长成了一小片。

entries.meaningZh: 薯蓣属植物 Dioscorea alata（white yam 的一个词典义）
entries.en: The farmer set aside a white yam for the crop display at the village hall.
entries.zh: 农民留出了一株 Dioscorea alata，准备参加村礼堂的作物展示。

entries.meaningZh: 白皮北美松（Pinus albicaulis），北美西部的一种松树
entries.en: A bent whitebark pine rose above the low shrubs on the ridge.
entries.zh: 山脊上的低矮灌木丛中耸立着一棵弯曲的 Pinus albicaulis。

entries.meaningZh: Pinus albicaulis 的英文别名，一种北美西部松树
entries.en: The botanist collected fallen needles beneath the whitebarked pine.
entries.zh: 植物学家在那棵 Pinus albicaulis 下收集了掉落的松针。

entries.meaningZh: 扇尾沙锥（Gallinago gallinago）的一个英文别名
entries.en: A whole snipe rose suddenly from the wet grass and flew across the ditch.
entries.zh: 一只扇尾沙锥突然从湿草中飞起，越过了水沟。

entries.meaningZh: Aster acuminatus，一种叶片看似轮生的北美多年生植物
entries.en: The whorled aster was almost hidden among the ferns beside the path.
entries.zh: 那株 Aster acuminatus 几乎藏在了小径旁的蕨类植物中。

entries.meaningZh: 风轮菜属草本 Clinopodium vulgare 的英文俗名
entries.en: She rubbed a leaf of wild basil between her fingers and noticed its scent.
entries.zh: 她用手指揉了揉 Clinopodium vulgare 的一片叶子，闻到了它的香味。

entries.meaningZh: 野生芹（Apium graveolens，wild celery 的一个植物义）
entries.en: The researcher compared the leaves of wild celery with those of the cultivated plants.
entries.zh: 研究人员把野生芹的叶子与栽培植株的叶子作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: Canella winterana，一种树皮芳香的常绿灌木或小乔木
entries.en: The gardener planted a wild cinnamon near the sunny wall.
entries.zh: 园丁在向阳的墙边种了一株 Canella winterana。

entries.meaningZh: 欧白英（Solanum dulcamara），一种有毒的多年生茄属藤本植物
entries.en: Woody nightshade had climbed through the old fence at the back of the garden.
entries.zh: 欧白英已经沿着花园后面的旧篱笆攀爬起来。

entries.meaningZh: Scirpus cyperinus，一种生有绒毛状小穗的北美莎草科植物
entries.en: The wool grass bent beneath the weight of its clustered seed heads.
entries.zh: Scirpus cyperinus 的茎被成簇的穗头压弯了。

entries.meaningZh: 绵毛熊果（Arctostaphylos tomentosa），一种加州灌木
entries.en: The young twigs of the woolly manzanita felt soft through the thin glove.
entries.zh: 隔着薄手套摸去，那株绵毛熊果的嫩枝很柔软。

entries.meaningZh: Cirsium flodmanii，一种叶有白色绒毛的北美蓟类植物
entries.en: A woolly thistle stood above the shorter plants beside the fence.
entries.zh: 一株 Cirsium flodmanii 高出篱笆旁其他较矮的植物。

entries.meaningZh: 详细拟订；逐步推敲完善
entries.en: The working out of the final design took longer than the team had expected.
entries.zh: 最终设计的详细拟订比团队预想的花了更长时间。

entries.meaningZh: 文字系统；书写体系
entries.en: The museum display explained how the writing system represented the sounds of the language.
entries.zh: 博物馆的展板解释了这种文字系统如何表示该语言的语音。

entries.meaningZh: 待印的文字材料；文字稿件
entries.en: The editor checked the written matter before the illustrations were added.
entries.zh: 编辑在加入插图之前检查了文字稿件。

entries.meaningZh: 欧洲山榆（Ulmus glabra，亦称无毛榆）
entries.en: The old wych elm sheltered a bench at the corner of the garden.
entries.zh: 花园角落那棵老欧洲山榆为一张长椅遮了阴。

entries.meaningZh: 长豇豆（Vigna unguiculata sesquipedalis），一种豆科作物
entries.en: A yard-long bean climbed the bamboo frame beside the vegetable bed.
entries.zh: 一株长豇豆沿着菜畦旁的竹架向上攀爬。

entries.meaningZh: 黄鲈（词典名 Morone interrupta），一种北美淡水鲈类鱼
entries.en: The researcher counted the fin rays of the yellow bass under a bright lamp.
entries.zh: 研究人员在明亮的灯下数了那条黄鲈的鳍条。

entries.meaningZh: 可用于制取染料或颜料的鼠李类果实
entries.en: The dyer crushed a yellow berry to show where the pigment came from.
entries.zh: 染色工碾碎了一颗可制染料的鼠李类果实，展示颜料的来源。

entries.meaningZh: 北美黄柏（词典名 Chamaecyparis nootkatensis），一种北美针叶树
entries.en: The yellow cedar stood above the smaller evergreens on the slope.
entries.zh: 那棵 Chamaecyparis nootkatensis 高出山坡上较小的常绿树。

entries.meaningZh: 钝叶酸模（Rumex obtusifolius，yellow dock 的一个植物义）
entries.en: A yellow dock had spread its broad leaves over the edge of the path.
entries.zh: 一株钝叶酸模把宽大的叶子伸展到了小径边上。

entries.meaningZh: Lonicera flava，一种开黄花的攀援忍冬
entries.en: The yellow honeysuckle twined around the wooden post near the gate.
entries.zh: 那株 Lonicera flava 绕着门旁的木柱攀援。

entries.meaningZh: 常绿钩吻（Gelsemium sempervirens），一种开黄花的有毒藤本植物
entries.en: The yellow jasmine covered part of the fence with yellow flowers.
entries.zh: 常绿钩吻的黄花覆盖了篱笆的一部分。

entries.meaningZh: 黄连花类植物 Lysimachia vulgaris
entries.en: Yellow loosestrife grew in a thick patch beside the narrow stream.
entries.zh: 溪流旁长着浓密的一片 Lysimachia vulgaris。

entries.meaningZh: 黄酸枣（Spondias mombin）的黄色果实
entries.en: She placed a ripe yellow mombin beside the other tropical fruit.
entries.zh: 她把一枚成熟的黄酸枣果实放在其他热带水果旁。

entries.meaningZh: 美洲黑栎（Quercus velutina），yellow oak 的一个树木义
entries.en: The forester marked the yellow oak before measuring its trunk.
entries.zh: 林务员在测量树干之前，给那棵美洲黑栎做了标记。

entries.meaningZh: 北美鹅掌楸（Liriodendron tulipifera）
entries.en: The yellow poplar had dropped several large leaves onto the lawn.
entries.zh: 那棵北美鹅掌楸的几片大叶子已经落在草坪上。

entries.meaningZh: 天蓝苜蓿（Medicago lupulina），一种开小黄花的草本植物
entries.en: Yellow trefoil grew close to the ground along the sunny bank.
entries.zh: 天蓝苜蓿贴着向阳的岸边地面生长。

entries.meaningZh: 埃及伊蚊（Aedes aegypti）
entries.en: The entomologist placed the yellow-fever mosquito under the microscope.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家把那只埃及伊蚊放到了显微镜下。

entries.meaningZh: 黄尾鲽（Limanda ferruginea），一种美洲比目鱼
entries.en: The fisheries officer recorded the length of the yellowtail flounder.
entries.zh: 渔业官员记录了那条黄尾鲽的长度。

entries.meaningZh: 你说对了；可不是嘛（表示赞同的非正式回应）
entries.en: 'That climb was exhausting.' 'You said it! My legs are still shaking.'
entries.zh: “那段攀登太累了。”“可不是嘛！我的腿还在发抖。”

entries.meaningZh: 零息债券；存续期间不支付定期利息的债券
entries.en: The report listed a zero-coupon bond among the company’s long-term investments.
entries.zh: 报告把一只零息债券列在了公司的长期投资中。
